d: Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.
Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group’s purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users’ well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.
Edenred’s 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.
In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

Edenred UAE is a fast growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 business and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions. We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll and for employees to receive their salaries and use it in the simplest way offering multiple value added services via our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge and card services).

d: An UHNW private family in Dubai is seeking a qualified and experienced Private Nurse with a strong background in newborn care and maternity or postnatal nursing. Midwifery qualifications or experience are highly preferred. The successful candidate will provide professional, attentive and discreet care for the newborn and support the mother during the postnatal period.
q: Recognized nursing qualification with relevant professional registration or licensing, as applicable.
At least 5 years of relevant experience in newborn care, maternity nursing or postnatal care. Midwifery qualification or practical midwifery experience highly preferred.
Strong knowledge of infant feeding, hygiene, newborn safety and safe-sleep practices.
Infant CPR and first-aid certification preferred.
Professional, compassionate, reliable and discreet, with sound judgement.
Previous private household or UHNW family experience is an advantage.
Professional references and appropriate background checks required.
r: Provide daily care for the newborn, ensuring comfort, hygiene and safety.
Monitor feeding, sleeping patterns and general well-being.
Support breastfeeding, bottle feeding and appropriate feeding routines.
Maintain hygiene and sterilization of feeding equipment and baby-care items.
Support the mother during the postnatal period within the scope of professional qualifications.
Recognize signs of illness or distress and coordinate with healthcare professionals when required.
Maintain accurate care records and protect the family's privacy.
Work collaboratively with the family and household staff.
x: Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
Employment visa sponsorship and medical insurance.
Paid annual leave in accordance with applicable UAE law and agreed employment terms.
Annual return flight or travel allowance.

d: تُعلن شركة المشورة للمحاماة والإستشارات القانونية عن رغبتها في إستقطاب (عدد من المُحامين المُرخصين) للإنضمام إلى فريقها القانوني بالدمام والرياض، وفقاً للشروط والمتطلبات التالية:
الحصول على رخصة محاماة سارية المفعول في المملكة العربية السعودية.
خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 3 سنوات في مجال المحاماة.
خبرة سابقة في العمل لدى مكاتب أو شركات المحاماة.
الإلمام التام بالأنظمة واللوائح القضائية في المملكة، ومتابعة التحديثات المستمرة التي تطرأ عليها.
القدرة العالية على إدارة القضايا، وتمثيل العملاء أمام المحاكم والجهات القضائية بمختلف درجاتها.
مهارات مُتقدمة في إعداد ومراجعة اللوائح، والمُذكرات القانونية، والإعتراضات.
القدرة على صياغة ومراجعة العقود، الإتفاقيات، وتقديم الإستشارات القانونية بدقة عالية.
مهارات قوية في البحث القانوني والصياغة القانونية.
